requirements.description: Exact protected cell, voltage/current/timer limits, sensor curve/leakage corners and divider isolation.
Holder, harness, connector, protection trip/recovery, power copper and peak/average demand.
Local decoupling, quiet TS/programming returns, external-input protection and EP thermal copper/vias against Figure37.
Input/load/temperature/timer and charger-to-regulator source cases with applicable models.
Actual cell temperature tracking, fault handling, voltage regulation, charging completion and battery/load transitions.
Optional ratiometric_ntc_divider screening with explicit independently justified sensor/leakage bounds; not thermal certification.
